title: Virtual environments and pip

spans.text: venv isolates dependencies per project. Create and activate an environment, install packages through that interpreter's pip, and record requirements in a requirements file.

spans.code:
python -m venv .venv
python -m pip install requests
python -m pip freeze > requirements.txt
Creates .venv, installs the package, and writes installed versions to requirements.txt; command output varies.

spans.text: venv separates project dependencies from system Python.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Calling pip as `python -m pip` reduces the risk of installing into the wrong interpreter.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Share setup instructions and dependency files, not the .venv directory itself.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
